question: Is Sagittarius A* dangerous to Earth?
short_answer: No, Sagittarius A* is 26,000 light-years away at the center of the Milky Way galaxy. Its gravitational influence is strictly confined to the central galactic bulge and poses no danger to Earth or the Solar System.
full_explanation: Containing ~4.1 million solar masses, Sgr A* governs the orbits of nearby S-stars. Because Earth is located in the galactic disk 26,000 light-years out, solar system dynamics are dominated by the local sun mass, not Sgr A*.
